Meet the Team
  
  
At Foundation AI, we are leading frontier AI research across Cisco. Our mission is to advance the state of AI. We translate that research into purpose-built models, agentic systems, new algorithms, optimization methods, and scalable data processing techniques that solve real-world problems at scale.
  
We explore new model architectures, pre-training and post-training methods, inference optimization, evaluation techniques, and data pipelines. Together, we are advancing AI at Cisco and for the broader AI community!
  
Our Infrastructure& Systems team builds the foundation that makes this research possible. We work closely with researchers to turn evolving experimental workflows into reliable, reusable systems for data preparation, model training, post-training, evaluation, and inference. Our work spans distributed GPU computing, cloud infrastructure, research tooling, and the systems that connect experiments, datasets, models, and results.

As an AI Researcher on the infrastructure team of Foundation AI, you will design, build, and operate the platforms that help our researchers move from an idea to a reproducible experiment and a deployable model. You will make complex AI workloads easier to launch, observe, debug, and scale.
  
You will own projects from identifying problems to building and operating solutions. jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

We're looking for a People Research Scientist to join our People Science and Workforce Intelligence team. jobs.title: AI Research Scientist/ Research Engineer: Materials Discovery
jobs.description:
At **Logical Intelligence**, our mission is to accelerate the discovery of materials that make the next generation of technology possible, from light emitters and semiconductors to batteries, electric vehicles, and the chips behind AI and robotics. Large language models alone are not enough to get there. Discovering new materials requires an understanding of chemistry and physics to guide the search, and energy-based models let us build that understanding directly into our discovery loop. We work closely with industry and lab partners to shorten the path from research to real products.

**About the Role**  
As a Research Scientist on our material discovery team, you will help turn that idea into new molecules. You will build the AI systems that propose and evaluate candidates, and work with our partner labs so that every synthesis and measurement teaches the models something. You will join a highly interdisciplinary team of chemists, physicists, and machine learning scientists and engineers, where the biggest impact comes from working together.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build and improve the AI systems behind our discovery loop, from candidate generation and screening to selecting which molecules to test next.
* Develop energy-based models that combine learned representations with physical and chemical knowledge to search chemical space more efficiently.
* Own model evaluation, including benchmarks on held-out chemical families, accuracy against both quantum-chemistry calculations and experiment, calibration of uncertainty estimates, prospective tests where the model predicts before the lab measures, and tracking across model versions.
* Compare AI predictions with measurements, investigate disagreements, and turn what you learn into concrete model changes, in collaboration with AI researchers and engineers.
* Design experiments with our partner labs so that each round of synthesis and testing is as informative as possible.

**You Will Thrive in This Role If You Have**

* A background in machine learning, computational chemistry, physics, or a related field, with a PhD, or a Master’s plus relevant industry experience, and hands-on experience building ML models for real scientific problems.
* Familiarity with energy-based models, diffusion or score-based models, or similar generative approaches, and an interest in going deeper.
* Knowledge of chemistry, or a genuine interest in learning it alongside our chemists.
* Experience designing evaluations and experiments that correlate with downstream performance
* A strong record of impactful research, shown through publications, patents, open-source software, or methods used in real discovery programs.
* Excellent scientific writing and communication, and comfort working in an interdisciplinary team.

**Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have**

* Hands-on research experience with energy-based models, or with methods that combine learning with search and optimization.
* Experience with molecular ML, such as property prediction, generative molecular design, ML interatomic potentials, or quantum-chemistry workflows (e.g. DFT).
* Experience with closed-loop design using real lab feedback

jobs.title: Senior Applied Research Scientist
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

  

The Data and Agent Loop Lab is looking for a Senior Applied Research Scientist to help us build the next generation of multimodal search and curation systems for Physical AI. We're building the foundation for robots, autonomous vehicles, and intelligent machines that can perceive, reason, and act in the real world. The data that trains these systems is as important as the models themselves, and the team sits at the center of that challenge. You'll work alongside world-class researchers and engineers to solve some of the hardest data problems in AI — at petabyte scale, across video, sensor, and language modalities. Your work will directly shape what our foundation models learn, and will help external customers build their own Physical AI pipelines on top of NVIDIA's platform.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Researching and designing multimodal search and curation systems optimized for Physical AI data — video, lidar, radar, text, and more. These systems help researchers and customers find, filter, and surface the highest-quality data — including embedding-based retrieval, quality scoring models, active learning loops, and relevance evaluation frameworks.
* Developing datasets, benchmarks, and experimental frameworks that establish guidelines for data curation in robotics and AV contexts — and publishing those findings so the community can benefit.
* Translating research into production-grade software; writing papers, blog posts, and documentation that help customers understand and apply our methods.
Staying current with the latest in data curation, information retrieval, and multimodal learning — and bringing those insights back to the team.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* M.S. or Ph.D. in a relevant field — machine learning, information retrieval, robotics, AV, or multimodal AI (or equivalent experience)
* 8+ years of industry or research experience.
* Deep understanding of the data challenges specific to Physical AI.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals — experience shipping production-grade systems, not just research prototypes.
* Clear, compelling communication: you can write a great paper and explain a tradeoff to a non-expert collaborator!
Experience mentoring junior researchers or engineers is a plus.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Hands-on experience with data curation or search in robotics, autonomous vehicles, or embodied AI.
* Familiarity with model training pipelines and the role data quality plays in model performance.
* Experience with large-scale video data — collection, processing, and retrieval.
* Prior work on semantic or neural search (dense retrieval, CLIP-style embeddings, multimodal indexing).
Publications in top venues on data-centric AI, information retrieval, or multimodal learning.  

  

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package ( www.nvidiabenefits.com ), we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

### **The Position**

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximizing these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

  

**The Opportunity**

At Genentech (gRED) and Roche (pRED), we’re applying software, robotics, and advanced AI to solve one of humanity’s hardest challenges: building fully autonomous, self-healing laboratories for lights-out drug discovery. Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) and the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) team are building the foundational platform for autonomous labs—turning frontier AI models, rich physical telemetry, and multi-vendor robotics into resilient, intelligent systems that run complex science unattended around the clock to deliver life-saving medicines to patients faster than ever before.

As a Senior Multimodal Machine Learning Scientist, you will be the hands-on technical lead and architect developing intelligent systems for autonomous laboratories. Your work will span computer vision and multimodal perception, predictive modeling, agentic systems, and closed-loop experimentation, for example, unifying camera feeds with rich physical telemetry to give lab systems situational awareness and autonomous recovery capabilities. You will build and deploy models and end-to-end ML pipelines, from data collection and model development to evaluation and deployment, helping pioneer the next generation of intelligent laboratory infrastructure at global scale.

**In this role, you will:**

  

* Develop and fine-tune state-of-the-art vision models (VLMs, DinoV2, SAM, custom detection/segmentation) to perform real-time visual quality control across lab workcells (e.g., liquid level sensing, tip verification, labware orientation, spill/foam detection).
* Develop multimodal models that integrate camera feeds and video streams with time-series sensor telemetry, system logs, assay metadata, and other laboratory data to catch and understand physical failure modes.
* Build predictive AI models on rich analytical data (spectroscopy, plate-readers, chromatography) to quantify assay quality and support closed-loop experimental decision-making.
* Build the data and ML pipelines needed to support these systems end-to-end, including image/video and sensor data collection, curation, processing, labeling, model training, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement.
* Build agentic pipelines that interpret lab data, reason through multi-step experimental workflows, and execute autonomous recovery decisions.
* Build rigorous evaluation suites (evals) to systematically benchmark model and agent accuracy, robustness, and decision safety in drug discovery labs.
* Deploy and optimize scalable ML inference and monitoring infrastructure that is low-latency and can support diverse models, instruments, and scientific use cases.

**Who you are:**

  

* MS/PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related quantitative field with 3+ years of hands-on experience deploying production ML systems or translational research models.
* Passion for translating frontier AI into biological workflows and real-world therapeutic breakthroughs.
* Strong background in Computer Vision and Vision-Language Models (VLMs), with hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or evaluating visual perception architectures (e.g., PyTorch, OpenCV, torchvision, object detection/segmentation, vision-text transformers).
* Strong foundations in machine learning, statistics, and data analysis, with hands-on experience developing and deploying predictive and data-driven models.
* Proven track record building and deploying multimodal models that combine camera feeds/image streams with unstructured physical data (sensor logs, time-series, tabular scientific data).
* Hands-on experience building, orchestrating, or tuning agent harnesses.
* Demonstrated mastery in building comprehensive evaluation pipelines (evals) to benchmark model and agent accuracy, robustness, and safety in production environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across disciplines and translate scientific requirements into practical ML systems, collaborating with scientists, automation/robotics engineers, and software engineers.

**Preferred, but not required**

  

* Experience with synthetic vision data generation, video-based anomaly detection, or edge-vision deployment.
* Familiarity with lab automation hardware, analytical instruments (liquid handlers, plate readers, HPLC), or industrial IoT telemetry.
* Exposure to Bayesian optimization, active learning, reinforcement learning, or Design of Experiments (DoE) for closed-loop experimentation.
* Public GitHub/GitLab portfolio showcasing production ML pipelines, computer vision projects, agentic frameworks/evals, or multimodal models.

Relocation benefits are not available for this opportunity

jobs.title: Senior Vision Language Model Engineer
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is the platform upon which every new AI-powered application is built. We are seeking a senior vision language model engineer to design and build agentic data and training workflows for Autonomous Vehicles, Robotics, and Medical applications. The right person for this role brings technical innovation and collaborative culture to change the way NVIDIA builds dataset search platforms for physical AI developers. Our dataset search offerings are ease to use, performant and scalable. Your work will redefine the dataset search and model training capabilities in NVIDIA product offerings and impact the most iconic companies in Physical AI.

  

**What you'll be doing:**

* Partner with our researchers to develop and evaluate prototypes of our latest models, such as VLMs and VLAs, for video search, video understanding, and more. Enable fundamental advances in autonomous driving, healthcare, and robotics.
* Design and implement agentic data workflows that automate data discovery, labeling, evaluation, and retraining to maximize development velocity.
* Build, curate, and maintain high‑quality multimodal datasets (e.g., video, sensor, language/action traces) tailored for end‑to‑end physical AI problems, such as autonomous driving.
* Explore and productize new data sources including simulation and synthetic data.
* Use agentic AI workflows across the full applied research lifecycle.
* Collaborate with research, model development, performance, and product teams.
Contribute to NVIDIA Cosmos Dataset Search and other core NVIDIA platforms and products.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* PhD with 4+ years, MS with 6+ years, or BS (or equivalent experience) with 8+ years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
* Strong background in modern deep learning, including transformer‑based architectures, video modeling, and multimodal VLM/VLA or foundation models.
* Excellent experience training and deploying deep learning models on real‑world datasets: data preprocessing, distributed training, evaluation, debugging, and iterative improvement.
* Excellent experience with python and at least one deep learning framework.
* Current with the latest research on image and video search in autonomous vehicles, healthcare, robotics, or related physical AI applications.
* Fluent with agentic AI workflows across the full applied research lifecycle, including prototyping novel algorithms and search pipelines, benchmarking, and integrating prototypes in production codebases.
Clear and effective communication skills, with experience working well in a dynamic, product- and research-focused team.  

  

**Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:**

* Strong track record publishing in top-tier conference such as CVPR, NeuRIPS, ICML, ECCV
* Patents in video retrieval or related field
* Strong coding architecture skills demonstrated through contributions to large internal or open-source projects.
Experience in robotic systems such as autonomous vehicles or humanoid robotics.  

  

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package ( www.nvidiabenefits.com ), we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our best-in-class engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
  
184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits .

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 8, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Data Scientist
  
**Status:** Exempt
  
**Reports to:** VP - Business Services - Analytics and Risk
  
**Department:** Enterprise Reporting and Analytics
  
**Job Code:** 12031
  
**Pay Range:** $135,350.00 - $148,000.00 Annually
  
  
**WHO WE ARE:**  
Golden 1 Credit Union is among the top credit unions in the country. As a member-owned, not-for-profit cooperative, Golden 1 is guided by the credit union philosophy of “people helping people.” We are committed to empowering our members and uplifting our communities as we create a more equitable and financially inclusive California. We welcome all who embrace our Core Values.
  
  
**WHO YOU ARE:**  
You apply advanced analytics, data science, and quantitative techniques to transform complex enterprise data into actionable insights that drive strategic initiatives, product decisions, and business performance You are an analytics and data science professional who partners closely with business leaders and analytics peers to design, develop, and deliver sophisticated analytical solutions that drive data informed decision making across the organization. You translate complex and disparate data into clear, executive ready insights, leveraging strong technical rigor, sound methodology, and effective communication to support leadership visibility, forecasting, and long-term advancement of Golden 1’s analytics capabilities.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**  

* Advanced Analytics & Data Science \* Design, develop, and maintain advanced analytical and data science solutions that support business strategy and operational decision making. \* Apply statistical and AI/machine learning techniques to business problems such as segmentation, targeting, forecasting, and optimization. \* Manipulate, model, and analyze large, complex datasets using Python, SQL, and related tools to produce reliable and scalable insights.
* Analytics Solution Development \* Contribute to the development of repeatable and scalable analytics solution frameworks that enable the operationalization of data science models. \* Partner with data engineering teams to support data pipelines, model integration, and analytics workflows. \* Support experimentation, pilots, and minimum viable products (MVPs) aligned to defined business use cases.
* Business Partnership & Insight Delivery \* Translate complex and disparate data sources into clear data stories that enable data driven decision making. \* Develop executive ready dashboards, visualizations, and analytical summaries using tools such as Power BI. \* Prepare recurring and ad hoc analysis, reporting, and presentations to support management decision making, committee reviews, and enterprise information requests.
* Quality, Governance & Continuous Improvement \* Ensure analytical work products comply with applicable standards, policies, regulations, and systems of internal control. \* Maintain awareness of internal and external economic, market, and industry trends that may influence business outcomes. \* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance analytics methods, tools, and processes to improve efficiency and impact. \* Stay current on industry trends, and best practices related to analytics, risk modeling, AI, and machine learning.
* Experimentation & Innovation \* Design and evaluate experiments, tests, and proofs of concept to assess new analytical approaches, tools, and technologies. \* Proactively identify opportunities to automate, streamline, or enhance analytical and risk processes through improved data and modeling solutions.
* Collaboration & Development \* Partner effectively with product managers, analysts, engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver high quality analytics solutions. \* Provide guidance and informal mentorship to analysts on technical problem solving and analytics best practices. \* Contribute as a subject matter resource within the Enterprise Reporting & Analytics team.

**QUALIFICIATIONS AND PREFERENCES:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline required
* Master’s Degree preferred
* Equivalent relevant experience may be substituted for degree.
* 7+ years years of progressive experience in analytics, data science, or quantitative analysis, required including:
* 3+ years of experience with SAS, SQL, Python and/or R for statistical analysis and modeling required
* 3+ years of experience applying machine learning techniques in professional environments required
* Experience supporting analytics solutions within modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) preferred
* Financial services or other regulated industry experience preferred

**WHY JOIN US:**  
Golden 1 Credit Union provides its employees a market-competitive and internally equitable total rewards compensation package through a variety of programs. These programs are designed to attract, motivate, and retain employees that drive and support the achievement of Our Mission, Vision, and Strategic Goals. The Credit Union is committed a total rewards philosophy built on; a comprehensive compensation package, well-being and work-life balance, career development and growth, rewards and recognition, and a commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion. We believe in fostering a workplace where every employee is recognized, valued, and motivated to contribute their best.

jobs.description:
**Location: Palo Alto (hybrid)**

  

ERGO NEXT's mission is to help entrepreneurs thrive. We're doing that by building the only technology-led, full-stack provider of small business insurance in the industry, taking on the entire value chain and transforming the customer experience.

  

Simply put, wherever you find small businesses, you'll find ERGO NEXT.

  

Since 2016, we've helped hundreds of thousands of small business customers across the United States get fast, customized and affordable coverage. We're backed by industry leaders in insurance and tech, and we still have room to grow — that's where you come in.

  

As a Growth Data Scientist, you will use data to help shape how ERGO NEXT reaches, serves, and converts customers across our **partnership channel** and **customer experience funnel**. You will work closely with Product and Partnerships teams to identify growth opportunities, understand customer behavior, and turn insights into product and business decisions.

  

We're looking for someone who combines strong analytical and statistical skills with business judgment, curiosity, and a bias toward action. You should be comfortable working through ambiguous questions, developing a point of view, and using both traditional data science methods and emerging AI capabilities to make analysis more scalable, efficient, and impactful.

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Use AI as part of the day-to-day data science workflow and identify opportunities to develop reusable AI-enabled tools, skills, or agents that solve practical analytical and business problems.
* Drive strategy and roadmap for the Partnership channel and the customer experience funnel through actionable data insights.
* Own analytics for the entire customer experience funnel, from acquired opportunities to purchases.
* Design and evaluate experiments and causal analyses to measure the impact of product, funnel, and customer experience changes and guide future strategic decisions.
* Analyze affiliates performance across the partnership channel, identifying differences in traffic quality, conversion, product mix, and customer behavior to uncover opportunities to improve partner growth and customer outcomes.
* Identify, size, and prioritize growth opportunities, translating ambiguous business questions into rigorous analyses and actionable recommendations.
* Apply statistical analysis, segmentation, modeling, and deep-dive analysis to understand the underlying drivers of business performance.
* Define clear metrics, measurement frameworks, and visualizations to help business monitor performance and make data driven decisions.

  

**What We Need:**

* [4+] years of experience in Data Science or other highly quantitative analytical roles (experience working in fintech or growth & partnerships is a plus).
* Ability to quickly learn new AI capabilities, identify meaningful gaps in existing workflows, and apply or develop practical AI-enabled solutions that improve how data science work gets done.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience using Python or R for statistical analysis and analytical workflows.
* Strong foundation in statistics, experimentation, and causal inference.
* Experience with experiment design, implementation, analysis, and recommendation for actionable insights
* Ability to define the appropriate metric framework to empower the data-driven decision-making process
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analyses into clear recommendations and influence cross-functional stakeholders.
* Experience analyzing customer journeys, conversion funnels, or growth with the ability to connect changes in metrics to underlying business drivers.
* Experience working with partnership or other multi-channel business models, with the ability to evaluate partner performance.

  

**Unstoppable Qualities:**

* A builder mindset, with an interest in using data, automation, and AI to turn recurring analytical problems into scalable capabilities for the broader organization.

ambiguous_jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* PhD in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience leading a research agenda.
* 2 years of experience with machine learning algorithms, research methodologies, and language modeling.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 1 year of experience leading research efforts and influencing other researchers.

**About the job**
-----------------

The GenMedia Safety team develops the data and algorithmic solutions that define the safety and behavior of GDM’s latest image and video generation models. In this role, you will build and deploy innovations that impact millions of users. This is a collaborative role focused on delivering effective outcomes across our internal and external platforms.

Artificial Intelligence could be one of humanity’s most useful inventions. At DeepMind, we are a team of scientists, engineers, machine learning experts and more, working together to advance the state of the art in artificial intelligence. We use our technologies for public benefit and scientific discovery, and collaborate with others on critical issues, ensuring safety and ethics are the priority.

You will be comfortable both with designing approaches to new research questions and executing the technical implementation of research ideas. You will have the opportunity to work directly on Nano Banana (GDM's core image generation capability), OMNI (GDM's core video generation capability), and successor GenMedia models. We drive the development of the foundational technology adopted by numerous product areas including Gemini App, Cloud API, Search, and YouTube.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop solutions for GenMedia models that balance user experience, safety, and scalability.
* Utilize data and algorithmic reasoning to ensure image-generation models remain safe, and helpful.
* Collaborate with policy experts to convert, ambiguous safety guidelines into actionable technical implementations.
* Design and maintain protocols to identify and bridge gaps in model safety.
* Execute experiments to inform safety strategies while innovating rapid, scalable mitigations for high-priority, time-sensitive escalations.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.
